title: A stored `auth.email_password_enabled` re-advertises email and password on a cloud-managed runtime that declared it off
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing gate: ① a product defect, read from code at the pin and confirmed by the contract review of cloud PR #4589 (card cloud#4535), which judged it acceptable as a follow-up. The cloud half (hosted builds with `emailAndPassword.enabled: false`, and the relay refuses every password door) is PR #4589. Reader: the `domain:server` lane (`plugin-auth`).

## 维护者速读

cloud#4535 让托管环境以 `emailAndPassword.enabled: false` 构建，`/auth/config` 因此不再宣称密码登录。但框架的设置层会把已存储的 `auth.email_password_enabled` 覆盖到声明之上：托管环境的管理员在 Setup → 设置 → 认证 里把「启用邮箱/密码登录」打开并保存，`/auth/config` 就重新宣称 `emailPassword.enabled: true`，登录页重新画出表单，而 cloud 的中继仍对每次提交回 409。托管（`isCloudManaged()`）环境上这个开关应当不可重新打开（保存时拒绝，或者设置层对托管环境不应用该键）。

## Facts (objectstack at b914e7247f; read from code, not measured on a running stack)

- `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` ~L2518 (`bindAuthSettings`): an explicit
  `email_password_enabled` is applied with `applyConfigPatch({ emailAndPassword: { enabled } })`,
  over the deployment's declaration.
- `getPublicConfig()` (`auth-manager.ts` ~L5796) answers `emailPassword.enabled` from that patched
  config.
- `sign-in-method-floor.ts` refuses only turning the toggle OFF with nothing else in force;
  turning it ON is never refused.
- On a managed runtime the password doors are refused by the host (cloud relay, cloud#4468 /
  cloud#4535), so a re-advertised form leads only to 409s.

## Expected

On a cloud-managed runtime (`isCloudManaged()`), email and password stay off once the host
declares them off: the settings save of `auth.email_password_enabled = true` is refused (write
predicate, same door as the sign-in floor) or the key is not applied there, and `/auth/config`
keeps answering `false`. Self-hosted deployments keep the toggle as today.

Seam: spec:`auth.email_password_enabled` (setting) → runtime:`bindAuthSettings` / `getPublicConfig().emailPassword.enabled`
Dedupe words: managed email_password_enabled setting override, cloud-managed re-enable password login, emailAndPassword declared off settings

## Also check on the same door (review nit)

`POST admin/update-user`: whether better-auth (the version at the pin) accepts `data.password` there was not readable in the review tree. If it does, the hash admits nobody on hosted (the relay refuses every password sign-in). It still belongs with this card: a managed runtime should not take a local password through any admin door.
